Modified by FitLog, 2026-10-14:
Extracted RoundedRectSDF, RoundedRectRefractionShaderString and DefaultHighlightShaderString
from backdrop/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/kyant/backdrop/internal/Shaders.kt.
Replaced multiplatform effect/cache wrappers with native Android RuntimeShader,
RenderEffect and Compose ShaderBrush adapters. Retained upstream AGSL equations.
Added FitLog material presets, icon-core contrast protection, local halo and fallback policy.
This distribution does not include the complete Backdrop library.

Modified by FitLog, 2026-10-17:
Added native Material button adapters and CONTROL lens parameters using the existing
Apache-2.0 shader adaptation. LiquidButton/LiquidToggle examples were design references;
the high-level multiplatform components and their gesture implementations were not copied.
Preserved upstream shader attribution and license; no complete library dependency added.
